description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics covered in the dataset used for AI/NLP Research, specifically relating to the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” The chart contains ten slices representing different categories. The largest slice, labeled “Business” and colored blue, occupies approximately 24.3% of the chart. Following this is “Econ. & Fin.” at 18.4%, “Game&Anime” at 8.2%, “History” at 8.2%, “Law” at 5.1%, “Science” at 6.7%, “Math” at 1.2%, “Geography” at 2.7%, “Med & Health” at 5.9%, and “Pet & Animal” at 5.5%. The chart includes a legend listing each category and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size, moving clockwise around the circle. Finally, a small slice labeled “Daily Life” occupies 7.1% of the chart.
